title: Identify the names of events that had more than 20 attendees, were not fund
question: Identify the names of events that had more than 20 attendees, were not fundraisers, and included at least one expense over $50 incurred by a member who wears an X-Large t-shirt.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e."XCL_011"
FROM event AS e
INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON e."XCL_010" = a."XCL_001"
WHERE e."XCL_010" IN (
    SELECT b."XCL_009"
    FROM budget AS b
    INNER JOIN expense AS ex ON b."XCL_003" = ex."XCL_023"
    INNER JOIN member AS m ON ex."XCL_022" = m."XCL_034"
    WHERE ex."XCL_020" > 50
      AND m."XCL_039" = 'X-Large'
)
GROUP BY e."XCL_010", e."XCL_011"
HAVING COUNT(a."XCL_001") > 20
   AND e."XCL_013" <> 'Fundraiser'
